decision_rule.defer_or_kill_if: All required internal surfaces are >= 0.30 and within 0.15 absolute of same-run post-block leaving.
decision_rule.falcon_followup: Run Falcon-H1-0.5B-Instruct only after Granite identifies a materially lower internal surface.
decision_rule.promote_if: Any internal Granite surface has strict_set_leaving < 0.30 while same-run post_block_residual_block_output remains high, or the internal surface is at least 0.15 absolute below same-run post-block leaving.
